This table can be seen on [[Language#Verbs]] (and elsewhere). It is set to be [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Manual:Collapsible_elements collapsed by default].

These are the in-game verbs that the game uses, with, among other things, titles, sites, and regions. After nouns and adjectives, verbs are the third most numerous word category in The game's four fictional languages - Dwarven, Elvish, Goblin and Human.

== Usage ==

To output the table cut and paste: '''<nowiki>{{Verb dictionary}}</nowiki>'''
